potential.name: SPC/E water + Joung-Cheatham Na+/Cl- (Wolf/DSF)
potential.implementation: bench/reference/fast_calculators.py:JCSPCEWolf — LJ (Lorentz-Berthelot, energy-shifted at rc) between O and ion sites plus damped-shifted-force (Wolf) electrostatics on all charged sites; intramolecular water pairs excluded

citation.water: H. J. C. Berendsen, J. R. Grigera, T. P. Straatsma, J. Phys. Chem. 91, 6269 (1987), SPC/E model
citation.ions: I. S. Joung, T. E. Cheatham III, J. Phys. Chem. B 112, 9020 (2008), Table 3, SPC/E parameter set
citation.electrostatics: C. J. Fennell, J. D. Gezelter, J. Chem. Phys. 124, 234104 (2006), damped shifted force method

wolf_dsf.formula: V(r) = q_i q_j k [erfc(a r)/r - erfc(a rc)/rc + (r-rc)(erfc(a rc)/rc^2 + (2a/sqrt(pi)) exp(-a^2 rc^2)/rc)]

units.note: rigid SPC/E water on the same machinery as water_tip4p; SPC/E is the solvent the Joung-Cheatham ion parameters were fitted for

protocol.description: 540 rigid SPC/E waters + 10 Na+ + 10 Cl- (1.03 M), rho=1.037 g/cm3 (L=25.4652 A): water O on a 9^3 grid subset with random orientations; each Na+ replaces one grid water, each Cl- replaces two (its site and the nearest neighbour, placed at the midpoint so the anion starts with a ~3.2 A cavity); FIRE (fmax 0.05 eV/A); Langevin NVT dt=1 fs, friction 0.05 per ASE time unit: 1.5 ps at 350 K, 8.5 ps at 300 K (10 ps total equilibration, Review 2: ion pairing needs longer than the previous 3.5 ps), then 5 frames at 1 ps intervals at 300 K

min_pairs.note: LJ wall ~0.72 sigma_LB(Cl,O); epsilon_Cl is tiny, 0.8 sigma sits inside the equilibrium shell
Coulomb attraction pulls the contact pair inside sigma; floor clears the 10 kBT wall at 0.72 sigma
Coulomb-only H sites: guard floor below any physical hydrogen-bond contact

gr_peaks.note: Joung-Cheatham report Cl-O ~3.19 A in SPC/E
Joung-Cheatham report Na-O ~2.35 A in SPC/E
